verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents fast-start tooling: SDKs and prebuilt UIs to "get started quickly", website plugins, a hosted online checkout and payment links. Together these suggest a founder could start collecting payments without much custom build. However, nothing in the evidence addresses how long account activation or KYC takes, or confirms that card acceptance can go live within a day of signup. Missing for 10: documented signup-to-live timeline or KYC/activation turnaround, explicit card acceptance in checkout and payment links, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day go-live.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
Our online checkout features our smart payment ordering system, incredible speed, and beautiful simplicity.
Receive one-off or recurring payments from anyone, anywhere, via your unique payment link.
